newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products-Steady to firm, gasoline stocked.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products-Steady to firm, gasoline stocked.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products ended steady to higher on Monday.
Gas oil was still finding some support from traders looking to move material east, but the enthusiasm to arb out of the region was waning.
"People are a bit nervous that Asia will turn against them and that they will be caught," said one trader commenting on the market concern that strong Asian prices will deflate.
Russian gas oil was holding broadly steady at around high cif quotes +$2-3 amid reasonable short-term tightness. Some traders said the arb east will evaporate producing length again.
EC spec gas oil was seen holding steady from Friday when a 25-30,000 tonne cargo was sold at cif high quotes +$3.50 for March 21-28 dates.

Gasoline was fairly well balanced in Italy, France and Spain with most players having stocked up ahead of spring refinery maintenance scheduled at a number of Mediterranean refineries over the coming weeks.

There was some demand out of Turkey and Libya for low octane leaded material. State Turkish oil company Tupras was reported to have tendered for 25,000 tonnes of such material. The tender will be awarded on March 19.
Naphtha remained tight after the recent clean-out of material by Eastern buyers.
